summary_en: Three consolidated subsidiaries (ULS Consulting, PeaceMeal Technology, Arkway) to be made wholly owned via simplified share exchange. ULS Group issues 202,200 shares to acquire ULS Consulting (exchange ratio 1:1,011). Additional subsidiaries' exchange details in full disclosure. Effective 2026-10-01. Purpose: unified group management and operational efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Complete Subsidiary Status of Three Consolidated Subsidiaries Through Simplified Share Exchange
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-29, ULS Group's board of directors resolved to acquire full ownership of three consolidated subsidiaries—ULS Consulting, PeaceMeal Technology, and Arkway—via simplified share exchange. ULS Group will issue 202,200 ordinary shares to acquire all outstanding shares of ULS Consulting held by minority shareholders at an exchange ratio of 1 ULS Consulting share per 1,011 ULS Group shares; the filing indicates that ULS Group's own holdings of ULS Consulting shares will not participate in the exchange. The exchange for ULS Consulting qualifies as a simplified exchange under the Companies Act (Article 796(2)), so ULS Group does not require shareholder approval. ULS Consulting's exchange qualifies as a short-form exchange (Article 784(1)), waiving its shareholder vote. The other two subsidiaries' exchange ratios and share counts appear in the full disclosure (not excerpted here). Effective date is 2026-10-01. The stated purpose is to enhance group-wide unified management and operational efficiency in response to evolving business conditions. Fractional share handling and request-to-buy rights for fractional holders are provided for under law.
